question: Can lineage-wide phylogenetic-memory context be explained by family composition in woodiness or life history?

predictors.woody_fraction: fraction of species with unique modal woodiness state == woody
predictors.perennial_fraction: fraction of species with unique modal life_history state in {perennial, short_lived_perennial}

species_state: unique modal categorical state after dataset_id + observation_id record deduplication; tied species excluded
test: two-sided Spearman correlation of family BLUP with each predictor
role: Post-outcome exploratory biological mechanism screen only.
hard_nonclaims: Australian-flora family composition need not represent global family composition.
Association does not establish a causal mechanism.
No result may alter the prospective AusTraits decisions.
